acceptance_predicates.description: Independent workers access the same project only through the supported handoffctl routes, with no direct authority mutation.
The workload records phase-level acquisition wait, lock hold, timeout, queue-depth, and throughput distributions at multiple concurrency levels.
The evidence identifies the specific critical sections and routes responsible for worker stalls, including any projection, reconciliation, or publication work held under the coordinator lock.
A concrete bounded design or implementation materially improves contention while preserving serializable task transitions, fencing, durability, and fail-closed recovery.
Interruption, timeout, stale owner, competing worker, and crash/recovery tests remain safe and leave no false task outcome.

definition_of_done: The contention workload and baseline results are reproducible on a fresh isolated project state.
The scalability bottleneck and a measured solution or justified no-change decision are independently reviewed.
Exact-head hosted checks, required formal/concurrency review, and state reconciliation pass.

inputs.description: The supported claim, heartbeat, update, release, run, snapshot, doctor, and reconcile routes.
The configured SQLite-WAL or Git-backed coordinator authority and its shared lock path.
The project development guide requiring handoffctl routing and truthful durable state.

outputs.description: Privacy-safe reproducible baseline and bottleneck report.
Reviewed implementation or bounded design with evidence of improved concurrent-worker behavior.

gates.description: Every mutating state transition remains serialized or otherwise proven equivalent, fenced, durable, and fail-closed.
The proposed or implemented change is compared with the baseline at the same worker counts and route mix.
A distinct reviewer checks the exact candidate head, measurements, and concurrency claims.
